systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_HORMUZ: 2 vessels/day (-97.8% vs 2023 Base) | CHOKE_TURKISH_STRAITS: -40.7% vs 2023 Base
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Diplomatic statements and headline reporting generally emphasize corridor continuity and stabilization efforts.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Catastrophic multi-corridor maritime paralysis; CHOKE_HORMUZ collapsed by -97.8% vs 2023 baseline, with 3 primary global chokepoints simultaneously contracting over 30% (Hormuz: 2 vessels/day, -97.8% vs 2023 Base; Turkish Straits: -40.7% vs 2023 Base). Standard commercial transit is structurally suspended, forcing naval escorts and AIS dark voyages.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Trade overviews tend to highlight the immediate dampening effect of direct bilateral technology export controls.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Severe technology supply chain friction; Model 25.14 AI Chip Stress at 0.524 (ELEVATED_SEMICONDUCTOR_BOTTLENECK) cross-referenced with elevated NY Fed GSCPI pressure (1.26 Z-Score). Direct US-to-China chip export contraction (-8.42% MoM velocity) combined with heavy Asian import concentration (Taiwan: $6,809,991,106 USD, Korea: $7,156,474,554 USD) indicates active trade rerouting via secondary Asian hubs, inflating hardware transaction costs.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: MODEL_28_4_SPILLOVER: 50 (MODERATE_FRICTION) | Net Deficit: 13.36 mbpd (65.2%) | IL_IR Polarity: -0.87
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Public infrastructure reviews often cite overland pipeline capacity as an adaptable alternative to maritime bottlenecks.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Critical pipeline bypass insufficiency; Model 28.4 establishes that overland pipelines (7.14 mbpd buffer) leave a massive 13.36 mbpd deficit (65.2% unmet) relative to baseline flows (20.50 mbpd). Under acute kinetic tension (IL_IR polarity: -0.87), Red Sea terminal vulnerabilities (Yanbu) eliminate operational redundancy.

systemic_contagion_rules.telemetry_signal: CHOKE_MALACCA: 258 vessels/day (+31.8% vs 2023 Base) | US_CN Baseline Polarity: -0.65 | NYFED_GSCPI: 1.26 Z-Score
systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Regulatory announcements typically frame export licensing regimes primarily through the lens of direct bilateral trade balances.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Acute secondary hub congestion and transshipment diversion; Malacca daily traffic surged +31.8% vs 2023 Base (258 vessels/day) amid elevated global supply chain friction (1.26 Z-Score). Under persistent bilateral friction (US_CN polarity: -0.65), trade flows are actively bypassing primary direct routes, triggering secondary compliance burdens, extended voyage delays, and warehouse congestion across Southeast Asian hubs.

systemic_contagion_rules.media_claim_bias: Financial commentary frequently characterizes precious metals rallies as routine commodity inflation or speculative trading cycles.
systemic_contagion_rules.ground_truth_reality: Monetary hedge accumulation and geopolitical premium; Gold/Silver Ratio at 82.2 (Spot Gold: $3,750.60 via The Royal Mint / ECB FX, Silver: $45.61) combined with heightened volatility (VIX: 22.91, YoY: +30.84%). Confirms persistent sovereign reserve accumulation and currency debasement hedging rather than cyclical industrial demand.
